_comment: Policy-as-data for the cloud-ci-tier-dependency-acyclicity gate (Phase-0 capability-first reorg; ADR-0245/0280/0562). DATA, not code: the governed crate-root globs, the tier'd service roots, the tier'd CAPABILITY roots, the unclassified meta roots, the ADR-0280 S-rank order, the false-green floor, and the enforcement mode. THREE root classes, and the distinction is load-bearing: `service_roots` are `<root>/<svc>/**` trees whose tier unit is the 2-component service prefix (where the tier'd manifest.json lives); `capability_roots` are ADR-0562 `<capability>/<face>/<crate>` trees whose tier unit is the ROOT ITSELF (the second component is a FACE, so a 2-component prefix would name `iam/adapters`, not a tier-bearing unit) and whose tier is DECLARED by its `capability_registry_path` entry's `tier` + `substrate_dag_position.stratum` facets — never derived: a capability listed here whose registry entry declares no tier, or declares a stratum outside `stratum_rank_order`, is RED and non-baselineable (R6c), because either one compares NOTHING while the policy claims the root is enforced; `unclassified_roots` carry NO tier and every edge touching them is SKIPPED, so it is restricted by R6b to `meta_directories` of the CLOSED capability registry. A registered capability declared unclassified is a silent exemption, not a classification — that is what R6b REDs, and it is why this list must shrink to the meta ring as each capability moves to `capability_roots`. The Rust kernel hardcodes no repo fact; a different repo adopts the gate by repointing this policy. crate_root_globs mirror the root Cargo.toml workspace members (FRIC-1781069288/ADR-0538 globbed membership); the canonical resolver remains libs/oya-workspace-members-kernel — this list is the gate's own scan floor, kept in lockstep by the workspace-glob-coverage gate. enforcement is born advisory-baseline; flip to blocking only when tier-dependency-acyclicity-baseline.json reaches zero violations (post-strangler).
flip_to_blocking_trigger: Set enforcement to "blocking" when tier-dependency-acyclicity-baseline.json carries zero violations (the reorg strangler has fixed every substrate-inversion). Until then the gate reports baselined debt advisory-only and blocks ONLY on a NEW regression vs the frozen baseline.
